sentences.text: Jalāl ad-Dīn Muhammad Rūmī , also known as Jalāl ad-Dīn Muhammad Balkhī , Mevlânâ / Mawlānā -LRB- مولانا , `` our master '' -RRB- , Mevlevî / Mawlawī -LRB- مولوی , `` my master '' -RRB- , and more popularly simply as Rumi -LRB- 30 September 1207 -- 17 December 1273 -RRB- , was a 13th-century Persian Sunni Muslim poet , jurist , Islamic scholar , theologian , and Sufi mystic .	Persian	Persian language	Sunni	Sunni	Muhammad	Muhammad	Muslim	Muslim	poet	poet	jurist	jurist	Islamic scholar	ulama	theologian	theologian	Sufi	Sufism	mystic	mysticism

Rumi 's influence transcends national borders and ethnic divisions : Iranians , Tajiks , Turks , Greeks , Pashtuns , other Central Asian Muslims , and the Muslims of South Asia have greatly appreciated his spiritual legacy for the past seven centuries .	Iranians	Persian people	Tajiks	Tajiks	Turks	Turkish people	Greeks	Cappadocian Greeks	Pashtuns	Pashtun people	Central Asian Muslims	Central Asian peoples	South Asia	South Asia
His poems have been widely translated into many of the world 's languages and transposed into various formats .
Rumi has been described as the `` most popular poet '' and the `` best selling poet '' in the United States .	poet	poet

Rumi 's works are written mostly in Persian , but occasionally he also used Turkish , Arabic , and Greek , in his verse .	Persian	Persian language	Turkish	Turkish literature	Arabic	Arabic language	Greek	Cappadocian Greek
His Masnavi -LRB- Mathnawi -RRB- , composed in Konya , is considered one of the greatest poems of the Persian language .	Konya	Konya	Persian	Persian language
His works are widely read today in their original language across Greater Iran and the Persian-speaking world .	Persian	Persian language	Greater Iran	Greater Iran
Translations of his works are very popular , most notably in Turkey , Azerbaijan , the United States , and South Asia .	Turkey	Turkey	South Asia	South Asia	Azerbaijan	Azerbaijan

His poetry has influenced Persian literature , but also Turkish , Ottoman Turkish , Azerbaijani , as well as the literature of some other Turkic , Iranian , and Indo-Aryan languages including Chagatai , Urdu , Pashto , and Bengali .
